ttl=open(GRAPH_TTL).read()
import re,csv
# map URI -> (point_class, zone, extref)
pat=re.compile(r'bldg:([^#]+) a brick:([^ ;]+) ;.*?isPointOf bldg:([^ ;]+) ;.*?hasExternalReference <[^:]+:([^>]+)>',re.S)
# better parse per block
blocks=ttl.split('bldg:')
sensors={}
for b in blocks[1:]:
    name=b.split(' ',1)[0]
    if 'a brick:Electric_Power_Sensor' in b:
        m=re.search(r'isPointOf bldg:([^ ;]+)',b)
        zone=m.group(1) if m else None
        m2=re.search(r'hasExternalReference <[^>]+>([0-9a-f-]+)>',b)
        # extref format: urn:buildgraph:tsref:<uuid>
        m2=re.search(r'tsref:([0-9a-f-]+)>',b)
        sensors[name]=(zone,m2.group(1) if m2 else None)
zone_sensors={k:v for k,v in sensors.items() if v[0]}
print(len(zone_sensors))
for k,v in zone_sensors.items():
    print(k,v)
